title: Guards row
description: One row of the harness's guards file (sub-task 8.3): one guard's result on one run. Dense: every run has one row per guard in the guard spec. `result` is pass, fail, or not_applicable; `value` the measured quantity as a twelve-place decimal string, absent when the guard measured nothing; `threshold` the bound in force from the guard spec, absent for structural guards; `partner` the other run's workload id (c2_pair) or the rerun trace's hash (determinism); `reason` is required on fail. Empty CSV cells are absent here.
